newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see increased mid-protein demand.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see increased mid-protein demand.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw increased demand for mid-protein products, with most of the business done on nearby positions, dealers said.

"The high dollar kept business in soymeal slow, but the lower price levels in sunmeal sparked some buying interest, while fears of tight EU rapemeal supplies boosted trade in that product," one broker said.

Afloat Argentine sunmeal pellets changed hands at $144.50 a tonne cif Rotterdam, Oct at $148, Oct/Dec at $151 and Jan/March at $152 a tonne cif Rotterdam. around $15 under seller prices at the beginning of the month.
EU rapemeal traded at 28.25 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine for both Sept and Oct delivery. Nov/Jan, Jan/April and Feb/April all changed hands at 28.50 marks fob.
The only trades reported in soymeal was afloat Argentine material at $282.50 and $283 from two vessels.
"The strong dollar and calls for a weaker Chicago soymeal futures opening kept many buyers for soymeal sidelined," one dealer said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
